item.title: Lattice Configuration Generation with a Self-Learning Diffusion Model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Akio Tomiya
arXiv:2607.12587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that a diffusion sampler for lattice-field configurations can be trained without preparing training data by an external Monte Carlo calculation. Starting from exactly sampled configurations at β=0, we construct a self-bootstrap sampler, SLDiffusion, in which periodic Gaussian proposals with a fixed learned score are Metropolis--Hastings corrected, at each β, against the same physical target at every noise level, and only replay configurations from the resulting chain are used to train the score at the next stage. In the two-dimensional compact XY model, self-training proceeds from β=0.30 to 0.50 at L=4. At β=0.5, the energy and vortex densities for L=4,6,8,12 agree with independent Hybrid Monte Carlo calculations within 1.35σ. Volu…

item.title: 通用机器学习势在无机晶体结构全局优化中的性能
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Edan T. Marcial, Laxman Chaudhary, Olesya Gorbunova, Aleksey N. Kolmogorov
该研究系统评估十二种预训练通用机器学习势在无约束进化搜索中预测无机非磁性晶体基态结构的能力。作者比较了 M3GNet、MACE、SevenNet、Equiformer、MatterSim、GRACE、eSEN、Orb 和 PET 等模型，发现其在低能竞争相分辨能力上差异很大，从接近从头算精度到几乎不可预测不等。进一步测试表明，部分模型能够捕捉由细微电子结构效应引起的小能量差，但全局结构优化仍是通用机器学习势的严苛应用场景。

item.title: TXL Fusion：融合化学启发式与大语言模型的拓扑材料发现混合机器学习框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Arif Ullah, Rajibul Islam, Yangming Huang, Ghulam Hussain, Zahir Muhammad, Xiaoguang Li, Ming Yang
该研究提出 TXL Fusion，一种用于拓扑材料分类与发现的混合机器学习框架，结合化学启发式规则、物理可解释数值描述符和大语言模型生成的语义嵌入。模型利用空间群对称性、电子计数、轨道特征、成分相关拓扑启发式和物理感知语义表示，将材料分类为平庸材料、拓扑半金属和拓扑绝缘体。结果表明，该框架相较传统描述符基线提升了总体性能和少数类拓扑绝缘体识别能力，并可作为高通量预筛选工具以优先推荐候选拓扑半金属。
